Unicode 15.0.0 character data

OptiMiyoo's legacy Windows PowerShell text-input compatibility helper derives
limited property ranges from the Unicode Character Database and Emoji Data.
The embedded OptiMiyoo.InputTextV1 helper in app/ui/display.ps1 uses:
- Extended_Pictographic: 511 source rows, 3537 code points, merged into 78 ranges.
- Grapheme_Cluster_Break Control, CR and LF: 28 source rows, 3895 code points,
  merged into 17 ranges.

These ranges support caret movement and editing. They do not provide a complete
replacement for Unicode grapheme segmentation or define terminal cell widths.
The original data files are available from the upstream URLs below; only the
derived ranges are embedded in the application.

Emoji Data, version 15.0.0

https://www.unicode.org/Public/15.0.0/ucd/emoji/emoji-data.txt

Rule reference
Unicode Standard Annex #29, revision 41 (Unicode 15.0.0):
https://www.unicode.org/reports/tr29/tr29-41.html#Grapheme_Cluster_Boundary_Rules
The compatibility additions concern emoji modifiers/ZWJ and regional-indicator
pairing, with Control/CR/LF and malformed-surrogate barriers. Other boundaries
remain based on the installed .NET StringInfo implementation.
